calls.reason: The CJR/Tow Center review gives examples of hyped, anthropomorphic headlines, but it covers a wider period and does not measure how often coverage overstated intelligence or friendliness. "Too much" is also largely a value judgment.

Chatbot use grew a lot (OpenAI, Bing). Physicians rated 5–13% of chatbot medical answers unsafe, Vanderbilt records show 28 patients whose psychosis AI made worse, and a bromism poisoning case points to physical harm, though without chat logs.

A Marist poll from March 2023 found 30% of US adults trusted ChatGPT-type information a great deal or a good amount, which is a large segment. The GPT-4 system card from that month names overreliance on wrong outputs as a concrete risk.
